english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat. His father, Prancet, was taken away by the Dark Knights when they attacked Golyat a year earlier. {hero} rallied to the cause of the Walister Resistance, harrying the enemies of his people together with sister Catiua and friend Vyce.
  Aided by a band of Xenobians he met in Golyat, he freed Walister leader Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. He was then offered a place in the Walister Resistance, becoming captain of the Order of {order}.
  Called the Hero of Golyat by his people, he soon became a prominent figure in the Resistance.

  Con ayuda de xenobianos que conocio en Golyat, libero al lider Walister, el duque Ronwey, de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica. Luego se unio a la Resistencia Walister como capitan de la Orden de {order}.               
  Llamado el Heroe de Golyat por su gente, pronto fue una figura clave en la Resistencia.

english:
A member of the Walister Resistance hailing from Golyat. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Together with Sir Leonar he took part in the killing of Walister civilians at Balmamusa, hoping to unite his people against the enemy. For his loyalty he was made a senior officer of the Resistance.
  The enemy call him the "Butcher of Golyat," and he is hunted by those who know the truth behind the massacre at Balmamusa.
spanish_current:
Miembro de la Resistencia Walister oriundo de Golyat. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey de su cautiverio en el castillo Almorica. Junto a sir Leonar participo en la matanza de civiles Walister en Balmamusa para unir a su pueblo contra el enemigo. Por su lealtad fue nombrado oficial superior de la Resistencia.                 
  El enemigo lo llama "Carnicero de Golyat", y lo persiguen quienes conocen la verdad tras la matanza en Balmamusa.

english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Due to the massacre at Balmamusa he broke his ties with the Resistance and went into hiding with Catiua.
  In battle with Sir Leonar he learned the Duke planned to forge a secret treaty with the Dark Knights Loslorien. He set off for Rhime to stop the proceedings, but before he could act the duke was killed through Vyce's treachery. With the Resistance rudderless he offered to take the helm, and he now commands all of southern Valeria.

english:
A Bakram who was once a sibyl of the Order of Philaha. She is the daughter of Archiereus Mreuva. After escaping political strife in Heim, she continued to pass on the teachings of the Order with her father. She joined the upper echelons of the Order upon her father's disappearance, and her stoutness of heart garnered much trust from the congregation.
  She came upon Abuna Prancet while traveling the Corpsevale on the outskirts of Heim, and took the ailing abuna to Brigantys Castle. When {hero} came to the castle she arranged for them to meet, and later told him of his lineage.
  She then joined the Resistance in the hopes that it would lead her to her own father.

A Xenobian from Peshaval who once led the Beast Regiment of the Kingdom of New Xenobia.
  He is a close friend of Canopus. When Xenobia fell under the rule of the Sacred Xytegenian Empire, he bent to their will at first, reluctant to bring war upon his people.   After the Kingdom of New Xenobia was established, he traveled to the Holy Lodissian Empire.

A Loslorien commander from Niemaran, a small town in the borderlands of Lodis. He is of Bolmoccan descent.
  He is last born of the former Nildahme royal house, which once wielded great power throughout the Sea of Lhai region. The Holy Lodissian Empire saw the bountiful lands of the Kingdom of Nildahme as ripe for the taking. They staged an uprising among the enslaved masses from which the ruling house had fattened their purse, then sent in their armies. Fearing for his life, the King hastily abandoned all resistance, and yielded to the Lodissians. Since then the Bolmoccans have endured lives of servitude.
  Andoras fled from a skirmish with Resistance forces while on a covert assignment.

  Es el menor de la antigua casa real de Nildahme, que domino la region del mar de Lhai. El Sagrado Imperio de Lodis vio las ricas tierras de Nildahme listas para tomar. Incitaron un alzamiento de los esclavos de los que la casa real se enriquecia y enviaron sus ejercitos. El rey rindio todo por temor. Desde entonces, los bolmoccas viven en la servidumbre.

A disciple of the Sea God Vasque who survived a purge of the enemies of Hierophant Balbatos. Her village was attacked by Jeunan's wyrmknights, and now lies in ruin. A handful of survivors took shelter at Lhazan Fortress.
  Ocionne attacked a Bakram force advancing on the fortress with her dragons, but the fight did not go in her favor, and she was captured.
spanish_current:
Discipula del Dios del Mar Vasque sobrevivio a la purga del Hierofante Balbatos. Su aldea fue atacada por caballero Dragon de Jeunan y yace en ruinas. Pocos supervivientes se refugiaron en la Fortaleza de Lhazan.        
  Ocionne ataco con sus dragones a las tropas bakram que avanzaban a la fortaleza, pero la lucha no fue a su favor y fue capturada.

  She was possessed by Sirene when waylaid by pirates en route to Valeria to find her brother Canopus. She brought death upon Omish with her songs, but the curse was broken by {hero}. Though she joined the Order of {order} for a time, she was later dismissed by {hero}.
spanish_current:
Xenobiana de la ciudad de Peshaval en Charlom. Hermana de Canopus. Cantante de renombre, su voz calma el corazon de todos los que la escuchan. Las mujeres aladas rara vez se ven en publico, pero Iuria busca atencion.                    
  Fue poseida por Sirene cuando piratas la interceptaron en ruta a Valeria para hallar a su hermano Canopus. Trajo la muerte a Omish con sus cantos, pero {hero} rompio la maldicion. Aunque se unio a la Orden de {order} por un tiempo, despues fue expulsada por {hero}.

english: A Walister serving with the Order of {order}. He is a spellbinder with an air of confidence about him. Before war broke out he had a small apothecary in Almorica. He joined the Resistance when his wife became a casualty of the conflict. In the early days he put his experience to use by gathering herbs and preparing medicinal concoctions. When Duke Ronwey was imprisoned upon the defeat of the Walister army, he resolved to take up arms. Despite his advanced years, he does not shy from battle.

english:
Former captain of a band of pirates based in Qadriga Fortress who terrorized the surrounding waters. The pirates call themselves the "Free Seas," and set themselves above other sea raiders. Their wrath often falls upon naval ports, warships, and the vessels of nobles, and some say there is more to their actions than mere plundering.
  He offered to join forces with the Resistance, but was rebuffed. He was killed in the battle that ensued.
spanish_current:
Excapitan de una banda de piratas afincada en la Fortaleza de Qadriga que aterrorizaba las aguas cercanas. Los piratas se autodenominan los "Mares Libres" y se consideran superiores a otros saqueadores. Su ira suele caer sobre puertos navales, buques de guerra y embarcaciones de nobles; hay quien dice que sus actos van mas alla del pillaje.
  Ofrecio unirse a la Resistencia, pero fue rechazado y murio en la batalla.

english:
A Walister serving with the Order of {order}. She is an archer with the Knights of Almorica. Her father and brothers were also bowmen with the knights, but all perished in the early days of the war. Her pinpoint accuracy with the bow more than compensates for her lack of brute strength.
  She returned to her mother's side after the defeat of the Walister and the capture of Duke Ronwey. However, she returned to her post as soon as she received word of the Duke's rescue.
  She initially served with Leonar's troops, but then joined the Order of {order} after {hero} went to her aid at Krysaro.

english:
A Walister hailing from the town of Sezhun in Almorica who serves in the Order of {order}.
  House Montrose is a noble family that has produced a great many knights over the years, and they are known for their loyalty to the duke. They live by the motto, "Serve with each sweep of the blade."
  When Leonar was made leader of the duke's personal troops, Voltare was appointed his second in command. His steadfast nature and closeness in age to Leonar forged a strong bond between them.
  Following the recapture of Almorica Castle, he met with ambush while pursuing the Necromancer Nybeth with Leonar. After {hero} came to their rescue, he left Leonar's side and became a member of the Order of {order}.
spanish_current:
Un walister de la villa de Sezhun, en Almorica, que sirve en la Orden de {order}.
  La casa Montrose es una familia noble que ha dado muchos caballeros con los anos, y destaca por su lealtad al duque. Viven bajo el lema: "Servir con cada tajo de la espada".
  Cuando nombraron a Leonar lider de las tropas personales del duque, designaron a Voltare su segundo al mando. Su caracter firme y su edad cercana a la de Leonar crearon un fuerte vinculo entre ellos.
  Tras la reconquista del castillo de Almorica, cayo en una emboscada mientras perseguia al nigromante Nybeth con Leonar. Despues de que {hero} acudiera a rescatarlos, dejo el lado de Leonar y paso a formar parte de la Orden de {order}.

A Loslorien commander from Galius, seat of the Holy Lodissian Empire, and twin brother to Dame Ozma.
  He is an expert swordsman, receiving top honors from the Xanam Officer's Academy. After serving as commander of three regiments of the Ganan Division for a number of years, he was assigned to the Dark Knights. His sadistic nature is evident in his actions on the field of battle and in his questioning of prisoners.
  Ordered by Lanselot Tartaros to finish off remaining partisan forces, he headed to Boed Fortress with Dame Ozma.
spanish_current:
Comandante de Loslorien, de Galius, sede de Lodis, y hermano gemelo de lady Ozma.
  Es un esgrimista experto que se graduo con honores en la Academia de Oficiales de Xanam. Tras comandar tres regimientos de la Division Ganan durante varios anos, fue asignado a los Caballeros Oscuros. Su caracter sadico queda patente en el campo de batalla y al interrogar prisioneros.
  Bajo ordenes de Lanselot Tartaros de acabar con los partisanos restantes, partio hacia la fortaleza de Boed con Dama Ozma.

english:
A Bakram who serves as regent to the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom. Following the death of King Dorgalua, he aspired to rule Valeria himself.
  Though once a mere abuna in the Order of Philaha, he used his growing power in the church to intervene in the power struggle caused by the lack of a successor. He consolidated his political power by courting the favor of the noble and wealthy. Backed by the military might of Lodis to the north, he established the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom and installed himself as regent. The kingdom is headed by the heir of House Eltynaha due to their blood ties with Queen Vernotta, but it is Brantyn who rules.

Consolido su poder politico ganandose el favor de nobles y ricos. Con el respaldo militar de Lodis desde el norte, fundo el Reino de Bakram-Valeria y se nombro regente. El reino esta liderado por la heredera de la Casa Eltynaha debido a sus lazos de sangre con la reina Vernotta, pero es Brantyn quien gobierna.

english:
Leader of the Kingdom of Galgastan. After war broke out, he established a realm ruled by the descendant of Count Orlandeau, a former lord of Coritanae. He installed himself as regent under the pretense of guiding the young lord. He started the blood war to suppress the Walister and take the southern half of Valeria for his own. Within a few months he crushed the Walister forces and captured their leader, Duke Ronwey.
  Even fellow Galgastani voiced concern at his high-handed policies, but all were soon silenced. He is a ruthless and calculating man.

  Incluso otros Galgastani criticaron sus autoritarias politicas, pero todos fueron silenciados pronto. Es un hombre despiadado y calculador.

english:
A former abuna who is father to {hero}. He was the younger brother of Regent Brantyn, his true name Prancet Morne.
  He took in the illegitimate child of King Dorgalua born to the Queen's handmaiden Mannaflora, raising her as his own daughter, Catiua. He assumed the name Pavel to hide his connection to Brantyn.
  The Dark Knights carried him off during their attack on Golyat. They held him captive at Heim in an attempt to gain information regarding King Dorgalua's heir.
  He was released and taken in by the Order of Philaha after the princess came forward, but the serum used during his questioning left him on death's door. Before taking his last breath, he spoke to {hero} of Catiua's past and the path that lay before him.
spanish_current:
Un antiguo abuna que es padre de {hero}. Era el hermano menor del Regente Brantyn, su nombre real Prancet Morne.
  Acogio a la hija ilegitima del Rey Dorgalua y la sirvienta de la reina Mannaflora, criandola como su propia hija, Catiua. Asumio el nombre Pavel para ocultar su lazo con Brantyn.
  Los Caballeros Oscuros se lo llevaron durante su ataque a Golyat. Lo mantuvieron cautivo en Heim para obtener informacion sobre el heredero del Rey Dorgalua.
  Fue liberado y acogido por la Orden de Philaha tras revelarse la princesa, pero el suero usado en su interrogatorio lo dejo a las puertas de la muerte. Antes de dar su ultimo aliento, hablo con {hero} sobre el pasado de Catiua y el camino ante el.

  Rodrick defeated his foes with powerful magic that bent the very laws of nature, but so horrible was the destruction he wrought that his own people fled from him in terror. He was eventually brought to justice by King Dorgalua, and died in captivity.

A Bakram who was queen consort to the Dynast-King. She was born into the noble House Eltynaha, and the King took her as his queen upon uniting Valeria under his rule. After learning her handmaiden Mannaflora was with child by the King, Vernotta had her exiled.
  She later bore the King a son, but the child perished in an accident. The distraught Queen was beset by illness, and passed away at the tender age of 30.

  Mas tarde le dio un hijo al Rey, pero este perecio en un accidente. La afligida Reina sufrio una enfermedad y murio a la temprana edad de 30.

A Galgastani who served her clan in battle. Her surname, Canaletto, indicates she was of the people who inhabit the thickly forested region near the headwaters of the Theron river. The nomadic Canaletto are known for their peaceful nature, and it is rare for them to take part in warfare. However, those who tire of following the old ways of the tribe have been known to leave, and Wynoa may have simply grown restless.
  Assigned to lead a relief party, she was treating High Commander Gatialo when she encountered {hero} Pavel and was killed.

english:
A Bakram serving with the Tigers of Burnham.
  She was tasked with scouring the San Bronsa Ruins for the wondrous powers said to lie hidden there. Until the fall of Heim she belonged to a secret expedition squad reporting directly to Regent Morne. After the downfall of the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom she and a few allies joined the Tigers of Burnham.
  The Tigers are a faction of the Order of Philaha loyal to Brantyn who seek to rebuild the Bakram-Valerian Kingdom by locating the Apocrypha and a set of wondrous powers.

english:
A Bakram who is wed to the pirate Darza. She was born to nobility in Barnicia, but struck out on her own to escape the burden of her lineage. While at sea her ship was attacked by Darza's pirates, and she was taken to Ndamsa Fortress. She was unfazed by their threats of violence, and Darza grew fond of her spirited nature, keeping her always at his side. Veldrei eventually came to have feelings for Darza as well, and they married.
  At first she joined him on raids, but later stayed ashore to watch over their den after learning she carried Darza's child. Though usually calm and collected in front of the other pirates, she broke into tears upon hearing of Darza's death.
  She was defeated in battle by {hero} while attempting to avenge her husband's killing, but her life was spared.
spanish_current:
Una Bakram casada con el pirata Darza. Nacio en la nobleza de Barnicia, pero partio sola para escapar de la carga de su linaje. En el mar, su barco fue atacado por los piratas de Darza y la llevaron a la Fortaleza Ndamsa. Sus amenazas de violencia no la inmutaron, y Darza se prendo de su firme caracter, teniendola siempre a su lado. Con el tiempo Veldrei tambien sintio algo por Darza y se casaron.
  Al principio lo seguia en sus incursiones, pero luego se quedo en tierra para cuidar su guarida tras saber que esperaba un hijo de Darza. Aunque solia mantener la calma ante los demas piratas, rompio en llanto al saber de la muerte de Darza.
  Fue derrotada en batalla por {hero} al intentar vengar a su esposo, pero le perdonaron la vida.

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was the son of renowned architect Selba Brondel. Selba created many famed buildings, such as Heilingham Palace, also known as the Hanging Gardens. Orba taught at the Coritanae Academy of Arts while painting numerous works in his spare time. One of these, named "Opalescent Clouds," was presented to the late King Dorgalua, and now hangs in Heim Castle.
  Orba was a major proponent of the nationalism espoused by Hierophant Balbatos, and he volunteered to take up arms soon after war broke out.
  He encountered Resistance forces at Tynemouth while en route to Almorica, and was slain by {hero} Pavel.
spanish_current:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era hijo del renombrado arquitecto Selba Brondel. Selba creo varios edificios famosos, como el Palacio de Heilingham, conocido como los Jardines Colgantes. Orba dio clases en la Academia de Artes de Coritanae mientras pintaba en su tiempo libre. Una obra, "Nubes opalescentes", fue entregada al difunto rey Dorgalua y cuelga en el Castillo de Heim.
  Gran defensor del nacionalismo del jerarca Balbatos, fue voluntario tras estallar la guerra.
  Camino a Almorica, topo con la Resistencia en Tynemouth y fue abatido por {hero} Pavel.

english:
A Walister who served the New Walister Alliance. Gousin wanted to fight for his people, but his poor upbringing led to him resenting nobility, and he was hesitant to join the Resistance with Duke Ronwey at the helm. He later learned that the New Walister Alliance also sought self-governance for the Walister, and resolved to join them.
  Gousin was a devout follower of the Order of Philaha, which preaches that all are equal in the eyes of the Great Father. He prayed before each battle and at dusk each day, earning him the moniker "Gousin the Devout" among his fellow soldiers.
  While en route to Almorica to rally like-minded soldiers to the cause, he was killed by {hero} on the Golborza Plain. It seemed he had heard a great deal of {hero}'s sister, Catiua.
spanish_current:
Un walister que sirvio a la Nueva Alianza Walister. Gousin queria luchar por su pueblo, pero su humilde origen lo llevo a resentir a la nobleza, y vacilaba en unirse a la Resistencia con el duque Ronwey al frente. Mas tarde supo que la Nueva Alianza Walister tambien buscaba el autogobierno para los walister, y decidio unirse a ellos.
  Gousin era un devoto seguidor de la Orden de Philaha, que predica que todos son iguales ante el Gran Padre. Rezaba antes de cada batalla y al anochecer cada dia, ganandose el apodo de "Gousin el Devoto" entre sus camaradas.
  Camino a Almorica para convocar soldados afines a la causa, fue abatido por {hero} en la planicie de Golborza. Parecia haber oido hablar mucho de Catiua, la hermana de {hero}.

Gousin queria luchar por su pueblo, pero su humilde origen lo llevo a resentir a la nobleza, y vacilaba en unirse a la Resistencia con el duque Ronwey al frente. Mas tarde supo que la Nueva Alianza Walister tambien buscaba el autogobierno para los walister, y decidio unirse a ellos.
  Gousin era un devoto seguidor de la Orden de Philaha, que predica que todos son iguales ante el Gran Padre. Rezaba antes de cada batalla y al anochecer cada dia, ganandose el apodo de "Gousin el Devoto" entre sus camaradas.
  Camino a Almorica para convocar soldados afines a la causa, fue abatido por {hero} en la planicie de Golborza. Parecia haber oido hablar mucho de Catiua, la hermana de {hero}.

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was the son of renowned architect Selba Brondel. His twin brother Orba was slain by {hero} at Tynemouth.
  Garba had won fame as a political philosopher, penning works such as "The Creed of the Self-Deceived" and "Failings of Present-Day Doctrine." Though initially an advocate of progressive politics, he took a more nationalistic tone after hearing the words of Hierophant Balbatos. He stated in one address, "Nothing can assuage the resentment we harbor toward the Walister, though we may know it unjust." The way he calmly vanquished his opponents in argument earned him the name "Garba the Silver-Tongued."
  He was slain by {hero} Pavel on the Xeod Moors while marching to engage Resistance forces at Balmamusa.
spanish_current:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era hijo del renombrado arquitecto Selba Brondel. Su hermano gemelo Orba fue abatido por {hero} en Tynemouth.
  Garba gano fama como filosofo politico, autor de obras como "El credo de los ilusos" y "Fallos de la doctrina actual". Aunque al principio defendia ideas progresistas, adopto un tono mas nacionalista tras oir al jerarca Balbatos. Afirmo en un discurso: "Nada puede calmar el rencor que guardamos a los walister, aun sabiendo que es injusto". Su calma al vencer rivales en debate le valio el apodo "Garba Pico de Plata".
  Fue abatido por {hero} Pavel en los paramos de Xeod cuando marchaba a luchar contra la Resistencia en Balmamusa.

english:
A Bakram who served his clan in battle. He was the eldest son of House Grandier, a noble family of renown in Barnicia. He led the castle guard at Heim.
  House Grandier traces its lineage back to Lord Clemont of Barnicia, and many have held official posts over the generations. They also served as knights to King Dorgalua, and now hold sway in both military and civil matters.
  Latimer had frequented Heim Castle as a squire since his youth, seeking to hone his skills and become an exemplary knight. He was an accomplished man-at-arms and commander, well-liked by both his men and the people of Heim for his gallantry.
  These qualities led to him being charged with the defense of Heim Castle. He was killed fighting the Order of {order}.
spanish_current:
Un bakram que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Era el hijo mayor de la Casa Grandier, una noble familia de renombre en Barnicia. Lideraba la guardia del castillo de Heim.
  La Casa Grandier remonta su linaje a lord Clemont de Barnicia, y muchos han ocupado cargos oficiales por generaciones. Tambien sirvieron como caballeros al rey Dorgalua, y ahora influyen en asuntos militares y civiles.
  Latimer acudia al Castillo de Heim como escudero desde su juventud, buscando pulir sus dotes y ser un caballero ejemplar. Era un experto combatiente y comandante, muy apreciado por sus hombres y la gente de Heim por su gallardia.
  Esas cualidades llevaron a encomendarle la defensa del Castillo de Heim. Murio luchando contra la Orden de {order}.

english:
A guardian of the Palace of the Dead. The statues lining the halls of the palace are actually unlucky explorers turned to stone by her magic.
  Xadoba was hideously disfigured in her true form, but was said to appear as a beautiful maiden before visitors to the palace. Those who inhabit the realm of chaos are adept at manipulating mortal minds, and can bend them to their will with ease.
  Xadoba was defeated by {hero} after attempting to prevent his passage through the palace.
spanish_current:
Una guardiana del Palacio de los Muertos. Las estatuas que llenan los pasillos son exploradores desafortunados convertidos en piedra por su magia.
  Xadoba estaba horriblemente desfigurada en su forma real, pero decian que aparecia como una bella doncella ante los visitantes del palacio. Quienes habitan el reino del caos son diestros manipulando mentes mortales y las doblegan con facilidad.
  Xadoba fue derrotada por {hero} tras intentar impedir su paso por el palacio.

english:
A Galgastani who led a band of pirates that plagued the Obero Sea. He was born in one of the poorer quarters of Port Asyton, and spent his youth serving in a local tavern. There he became acquainted with the notorious pirate Lontera, and later joined his crew. When Lontera was executed by the Valerian army, Darza took the helm in his stead.
  His wife Veldrei was born to nobility, but became a pirate after Darza raided the vessel on which she had taken passage near Boed Fortress. Veldrei stayed ashore to watch over their den at Ndamsa Fortress after learning she carried Darza's child.
  Darza attacked members of the Liberation Front at Qadriga Fortress, commandeering their ship and cargo. However, before he could escape he was killed by Sir Folcurt and {hero}, who had arrived to free the hostages.
spanish_current:
Un galgastani que lideraba una banda pirata que asolaba el mar de Obero. Nacio en un barrio pobre de Port Asyton y sirvio de joven en una taberna local. Alli conocio al infame pirata Lontera y luego se unio a su tripulacion. Cuando el ejercito valeriano ejecuto a Lontera, Darza tomo el mando.
  Su esposa Veldrei era noble, pero se hizo pirata cuando Darza asalto el barco en el que viajaba cerca de la Fortaleza de Boed. Veldrei se quedo en tierra cuidando su guarida en la Fortaleza de Ndamsa tras saber que esperaba un hijo suyo.
  Darza ataco al Frente de Liberacion en la Fortaleza de Qadriga, tomando su nave y carga. Sin embargo, antes de huir fue abatido por sir Folcurt y {hero}, quienes acudieron a liberar a los rehenes.

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was a knight of House Didarro, a family of note in Coritanae. They have served the Lord of Coritanae for many generations, and are fiercely loyal to the Kingdom of Galgastan. Hektor was to wed Moldova until she fell in battle at Krysaro.
  He was garrisoned at Brigantys Castle under High Commander Xaebos, but later set off for the Bahanna Highlands to aid Moldova's sister, Cressida. He escorted Cressida to Brigantys Castle safely, but was then killed by the Order of {order}.
spanish_current:

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. He was a knight of House Didarro, a family of note in Coritanae. They have served the Lord of Coritanae for many generations, and are fiercely loyal to the Kingdom of Galgastan. He was garrisoned at Brigantys Castle under High Commander Xaebos.
  Unhappy at how the Hierophant's despotism had transformed the land he loved, he and his father Briam plotted to allow the Resistance to put an end to Balbatos. Hektor kept reports of the Resistance's advance from reaching Coritanae, and laid down his life, allowing the Resistance to take Brigantys Castle.

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. At the start of the war he led a group of bandits based in the Phorampa Wildwood, but a desire to defend his homeland prompted him to enlist as a man-at-arms.
  Though an experienced fighter, he lacked an understanding of the art of warfare, and was often mocked by other soldiers. In an attempt to prove himself he led an offensive against partisans at Almorica Castle. However, his poor reputation was only compounded when he was slain by those he sought to bring to justice. He met his end at the hands of {hero}, the Hero of Golyat himself.
spanish_current:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. Al inicio de la guerra lidero un grupo de bandidos en el Bosque de Phorampa, pero el deseo de defender su patria lo llevo a alistarse como combatiente.
  Aunque era un luchador experto, carecia de comprension del arte de la guerra y otros soldados solian burlarse de el. En un intento por probar su valia, lidero una ofensiva contra partisanos en el Castillo de Almorica. Sin embargo, su mala reputacion empeoro al ser abatido por quienes buscaba llevar ante la justicia. Encontro su fin a manos de {hero}, el mismisimo heroe de Golyat.

english: A Bakram who belonged to a special detachment sent to the Palace of the Dead at Regent Morne's behest to search for draconic magic. Born to a family of poisoners, she was well versed in the use of toxins and venoms. Her detachment included many such sages and masters of arcane lore, their task being the recovery of rare and legendary artifacts. She was killed in a clash with Resistance forces below the palace.

english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. During the reign of King Dorgalua, deadly swordfights were a popular form of entertainment among wealthy Bakram in Heim. Only gladiators were permitted to participate in these bouts to the death. These gladiators were deserters or criminals chosen for their fighting ability. By choosing the path of the gladiator they escaped execution and were granted a small chance of freedom.
  Brezen was once a gladiator himself, surviving numerous bouts to eventually win his liberty. His skill in battle saw him recruited into the army, but he was disliked by others for his vulgar manners. He was bullied mercilessly and made the target of much unjustified scorn. Perhaps because of this, his prowess on the field of battle waned.
  He was killed after clashing with {hero} Pavel on the Golborza Plain.
spanish_current:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. En el reinado del rey Dorgalua, los combates de espada mortales eran un entretenimiento popular entre los ricos bakram de Heim. Solo los gladiadores podian participar en estos duelos a muerte. Estos gladiadores eran desertores o criminales elegidos por su habilidad de combate. Al elegir el camino del gladiador escapaban de la ejecucion y obtenian una escasa opcion de libertad.
  Brezen fue gladiador, y tras sobrevivir a varios duelos al fin gano su libertad. Su destreza en batalla hizo que lo reclutaran en el ejercito, pero no agradaba a los demas por sus modales vulgares. Sufrio acoso sin piedad y fue blanco de desprecio injustificado. Quizas por esto, su destreza en el campo de batalla decayo.
  Fue abatido tras enfrentarse a {hero} Pavel en la Llanura de Golborza.

english:
An enigmatic young woman. Little is known of her except that she was not human, having taken possession of the body she inhabited. She is thought to have been a guardian of Ashmedai's palace―the Palace of the Dead―as she was conversant with the forces of chaos, and liches and other undead did her bidding.
  She was slain after a number of clashes with Resistance forces. However, if her final words are to be believed, her soul will live on beyond the loss of her corporeal form.
spanish_current:
Una joven enigmatica. Poco se sabe de ella salvo que no era humana, tras haber tomado posesion del cuerpo que habitaba. Se cree que era guardiana del palacio de Ashmedai―el Palacio de los Muertos―ya que conocia las fuerzas del caos, y liches y otros no muertos obedecian sus ordenes.
  Fue abatida tras varios enfrentamientos con fuerzas de la Resistencia. Sin embargo, si se cree en sus ultimas palabras, su alma vivira mas alla de la perdida de su forma corporea.

english:
A Galgastani who serves her clan in battle. She was apprenticed to the Necromancer Nybeth. By studying death in all its forms, she believed it would one day be possible to cheat death entirely.
  When Nybeth set out for Qadriga Fortress to conduct his experiments, she was ordered to stay behind in Krysaro. There she learned that Almorica Castle had fallen, and faced pursuit by the Walister Resistance. She cornered the Resistance forces using the undead creatures at her command, but was defeated upon the arrival of {hero}.
spanish_current:
Una galgastani que sirve a su clan en batalla. Fue aprendiz del nigromante Nybeth. Al estudiar la muerte en todas sus formas, creia que un dia seria posible burlar la muerte por completo.
  Cuando Nybeth partio a la Fortaleza de Qadriga a realizar sus experimentos, se le ordeno quedarse en Krysaro. Alli supo que el Castillo de Almorica habia caido y enfrento la persecucion de la Resistencia walister. Acorralo a la Resistencia con los no muertos bajo su mando, pero fue derrotada tras la llegada de {hero}.

  She was betrothed to Hektor, head of House Didarro of Coritanae, and their wedding was close at hand. She was killed in a battle against the Walister Resistance at Krysaro.
  Her father Nybeth later resurrected her, but failed to restore her memory, and she attacked her sister Cressida. Her soul was finally set to rest after Resistance forces defeated her once more.

english:
A Walister who once served with the Walister Resistance. She was a spiritualist at the village of Vanan near the border of Almorica, contacting the dead to pass on messages to their kin. Regardless of whether her talents were genuine, Ramidos brought peace to many grieving loved ones. Her father died at an early age, and it is clear that her mother instilled in her a strong sense of compassion.
  She lived in Vanan with her son's family, but all her kin were slain when the village was sacked in the early days of the war. She then joined the Walister Resistance as a spellbinder, specializing in offensive magic.
  She was killed in battle when {hero} arrived at Almorica Castle to free Catiua, who had been kidnapped by Xapan the Mercenary.

  Fue abatida en batalla cuando {hero} llego al Castillo de Almorica para liberar a Catiua, secuestrada por Xapan el mercenario.

english:
A Galgastani who served her clan in battle. House Apollinaire is a noble family related to former Lord of Coritanae, Count Orlandeau. For generations they have held seats in the House of Nobles, wielding great power throughout the region. Daesi Apollinaire, youngest daughter of the current family head, favored warfare over politics, eventually attaining the rank of commander.
  Galgastani commanders are charged with leading several legions of men, and are second in rank only to high commanders. Daesi was well suited to the role, demonstrating decisive leadership and superlative combat skills.
  She died attempting to fend off {hero}'s assault on Coritanae Keep.
spanish_current:
Una galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. La Casa Apollinaire es una familia noble emparentada con el antiguo lord de Coritanae, el conde Orlandeau. Por generaciones ocuparon puestos en la Camara de Nobles, ejerciendo gran poder en toda la region. Daesi Apollinaire, la hija menor del actual lider familiar, prefirio la guerra a la politica, alcanzando el rango de comandante.
  Los comandantes galgastani lideran varias legiones y solo los superan los altos comandantes. Daesi encajaba bien en el rol, demostrando liderazgo decisivo y gran destreza en combate.
  Murio al intentar repeler el asalto de {hero} al Fortin de Coritanae.

english:
A Galgastani who once fought for the armies of Galgastan.
  She was a necromancer who tampered with the souls of the dead. She studied under the Necromancer Nybeth together with her daughters Moldova and Cressida. They believed that necromancy allowed those who died before their time a chance to fulfill their ambitions.

english:
A Bakram serving his clan from the shadows. He was tasked with locating an artifact said to be hidden within Lhazan Fortress. While passing near Vasque he was set upon by Ocionne, but he repelled her attack. Learning that Ocionne was a survivor from Vasque, he forced her to lead him to the fortress.
  Reymos is dedicated to the dark art of necromancy. This is rare for one serving the Bakram army, where the Order of Philaha holds much sway. A man of cruel and callous nature, he seeks to bolster the army by reviving the fallen as undead under his command.
spanish_current:
Un bakram que sirve a su clan desde las sombras. Se le encargo localizar un artefacto que se decia oculto en la Fortaleza de Lhazan. Al pasar cerca de Vasque fue atacado por Ocionne, pero repelio su ataque. Al saber que Ocionne era una superviviente de Vasque, la obligo a guiarlo a la fortaleza.
  Reymos se dedica al arte de la nigromancia. Esto es raro en alguien del ejercito bakram, donde la Orden de Philaha influye mucho. Un hombre de naturaleza cruel e insensible, busca reforzar el ejercito resucitando a los caidos como no muertos bajo su mando.

english:
One of the golems created by the Wicce Deneb to aid her in her work. Punkin soon emerged as their leader due to her aggressive nature.
  She started life as a pumpkin, but took on human qualities through her strong desire to be treated fairly. Blamed for the banditry carried out at an abandoned village, she fought {hero} and was defeated. In the end she was allowed to take over Deneb's shop. She does brisk business, but has trouble keeping up with payments to Deneb and the other workers. She does appear to be enjoying herself, at least.
  Apparently she was taught the secret of becoming human by a sage she met in the Palace of the Dead, but she will say no more on the subject.
  In her spare time she busies herself growing pumpkins and perfecting her recipe for pumpkin pie.
spanish_current:
Uno de los golems creados por la Wicce Deneb para ayudarla en su trabajo. Punkin destaco pronto como su lider debido a su caracter agresivo.
  Inicio su vida como calabaza, pero adquirio rasgos humanos por su gran deseo de recibir un trato justo. Culpada por el bandidaje cometido en un pueblo abandonado, lucho contra {hero} y fue derrotada. Al final se le permitio hacerse cargo de la tienda de Deneb. Su negocio prospera, pero le cuesta cumplir los pagos a Deneb y a los otros trabajadores. Al menos parece estar disfrutando.
  Al parecer, un sabio que conocio en el Palacio de los Muertos le indico el secreto para hacerse humana, pero no dice mas del tema.
  En su tiempo libre se dedica a cultivar calabazas y perfeccionar su receta de pastel de calabaza.

  Al parecer, un sabio que conocio en el Palacio de los Muertos le indico el secreto para hacerse humana, pero no dice mas del tema.
  En su tiempo libre se dedica a cultivar calabazas y perfeccionar su receta de pastel de calabaza.

english:
An apparition said to prey upon the souls of the dead. She has an enchanting voice that brings death to the living and peace to the dead. Untold numbers of sailors and pirates have perished through Sirene's songs and found solace in her requiems. It is said she appears without fail at the outbreak of war.
  She took possession of the songstress Iuria and brought doom to Port Asyton before being defeated by {hero} at the Pirate's Graveyard.

english:
Use the Save command to save your progress to the storage media, and the Load command to resume a saved game. You can save or load from the world map at any time by selecting the Data command from the System Menu.

- Quick Saves -
  Select Return to Title (Quick Save) to save your game during battle. This will suspend the battle so you can resume it at a later time. To resume your game, select Single Player and then Continue on the title screen. Note that quick saves are not erased after being loaded.

english:
The game records your last 50 actions during battle. You can use the Chariot Tarot to call up this battle record and return to a previous point in a fight. When jumping to a previous point it is saved as a separate record, so you can compare results from before and after you retraced your steps.

- Using the Chariot Tarot -
  Press the {icon 9} button during the attack turn of one of your units or after interrupting the turns of others. You can also select Chariot Tarot from the System Menu.

- Same Actions, Same Results -
  If you perform the same actions after retracing your steps using the Chariot Tarot, the results will also be the same. You must perform different actions to change your fate in battle.

- Battle Log -
  Press the {icon 4} button while the Chariot Tarot is displayed to view a detailed log of each turn.
spanish_current:
El juego registra tus ultimas 50 acciones en batalla. Puedes usar el Tarot Carro para invocar este registro y volver a un punto previo. Al saltar atras, se guarda como un registro aparte para comparar resultados antes y despues de volver sobre tus pasos.

- Usando el Tarot Carro -
 Presiona el boton {icon 9} en el turno de ataque de una unidad o tras interrumpir turnos. Tambien puedes elegir Tarot Carro desde el Menu de sistema.

- Mismas acciones, Mismos resultados -
 Si haces lo mismo tras volver con el Tarot Carro, los resultados seran iguales. Debes cambiar tus acciones para alterar tu destino en combate.

- Registro de batalla -
 Presiona el boton {icon 4} con el Tarot Carro abierto para ver un registro detallado de cada turno.

english:
You can use the World Tarot to jump to certain points in previously completed areas of the story. These are called "anchor points."

- Moving Between Anchor Points -
  There are multiple anchor points in each chapter. You can view these by using the World Tarot command in the Warren Report. This time line is also used to select a specific anchor point to jump to.

- The Story is Reset -
  Your progress is saved as you pass each anchor point. When you jump to an anchor point, you resume playing from that point in the story. If you return to a point before an important decision is made, you can make that decision again.

- Your Party Remains Unchanged -
  Party details such as class levels, inventory, and war funds are retained when you jump to an anchor point. This is also true of units added to your party, though they may revert to guests not under your control depending on story developments. Even in these cases, they will always return to your party once their duties are complete.

- Lost Information -
  Each anchor point records your progress up to the point at which you passed it. For this reason, anything occurring after the selected anchor point will be lost.

 Tu progreso se guarda al pasar cada punto de anclaje. Al saltar a uno, sigues jugando desde ese punto de la historia. Si vuelves a un punto previo a una decision importante, puedes tomarla de nuevo.

english:
Each anchor point records your progress up to the point you passed it. The status of each unit relating to the story is also saved. This means that when you use the World Tarot, you may experience some inconsistencies.

  For example, assume you had dismissed Canopus before passing Anchor Point B. If you later jump to Anchor Point B using the World Tarot, even if Canopus happens to be in your party, the story will continue on as if he had been dismissed. The same is true of the information in the Warren Report.

- Updating Anchor Point Data -
  Each time you pass an anchor point the data it contains is updated. Using the example above, if you jump to an anchor point before Canopus was dismissed, then pass Anchor Point B again without dismissing him, the Anchor Point B data will be updated to reflect his presence in your party.

 Por ejemplo, si expulsaste a Canopus antes de pasar el punto de anclaje B y luego saltas de nuevo a ese punto usando el Tarot del Mundo, aun si Canopus esta en tu grupo, la trama seguira como si lo hubieras expulsado. Lo mismo aplica al Informe de Warren.

- Actualizacion de datos de punto de anclaje -

english:
You can move between various locations and customize your party on the world map.

- Main Menu -
  Press the {icon 3} button while the cursor is on your party to display the Main Menu for the world map. The Party and Warren Report commands can be used at any point on the map, while the Shop command only appears when your party is at a town or castle.

- Traversing the Map -
  To move to locations such as towns and castles, position the cursor over the desired destination and press the {icon 3} button. Events or battles may be triggered when you arrive at or pass through a map location.

- System Menu -
  Press the {icon 12} button to display the System Menu. Select the Data command to save your progress to the storage media, and the Options command to change settings such as the controls.

english:
When battle starts, the unit with the lowest RT (Recovery Time) acts first. AT (Attack Turn) indicates the order that units take action.

- Attack Turn -
  You can issue commands such as Move and Act on a unit's attack turn. To issue a command, select a unit and press the {icon 3} button. Main Menu commands such as Move and Act will be displayed on the screen.

- Interrupt -
  You cannot issue commands during the attack turns of units not under your control. Press the {icon 4} button if you wish to confirm the status of units at times such as this. This interrupts the current unit's attack turn and allows you to use commands.

- Interrupcion -
 No puedes dar ordenes durante los turnos de unidades fuera de tu control. Presiona el boton {icon 4} si deseas confirmar el estado de las unidades en esos momentos. Esto interrumpe el turno actual y te permite usar comandos.

english:
During battle the RT (Recovery Time) of units is compared to determine attack turn order, with units having lower RT taking their turn sooner. RT is determined by the base value for the unit, the weight of the equipment they carry, their class, and the actions they performed on their previous attack turn.

- Equipment Weight -
  Each piece of equipment displays a value for its weight. The greater its weight, the more it adds to the RT of units equipping it. It pays to take this into account when deciding which equipment to use.

- Class -
  Each class has a base RT value. The RT of similar units will vary depending on their class, affecting the order in which they act.

- Previous Attack Turn -
  Each action that is taken during an attack turn will have an impact on the RT for the next turn. This is determined by the distance covered with the Move command and the actions taken with Act and Skills commands. Equipment and spells also have RT values that are added to RT when they are used.

- Attack Turn List -
  When a unit is selected during battle, the row of units shown at the bottom of the screen indicates the expected AT order. To view the attack turn of all units in battle, press the {icon 4} button to display the Unit List, and use Sort Units to display them in order of attack turn.

  It is crucial to stay aware of which units will be acting next. Try to eliminate unnecessary actions to stay ahead of the enemy.

En batalla se compara el TE (tiempo de Espera) de las unidades para definir el orden de turno, actuando antes las de menor TE. El TE depende del valor base, el peso del equipo, la clase y las acciones del turno previo.

- Peso del equipo -
 Cada equipo muestra su peso. A mayor peso, mas suma al TE de quien lo lleva. Conviene tenerlo en cuenta al elegir equipo.

- Clase -
 Cada clase tiene un TE base. El TE de unidades similares varia segun su clase, afectando su orden de accion.

- Turno de ataque previo -
 Cada accion en un turno afecta el TE del siguiente. Esto se define por la distancia recorrida al Mover y las acciones de Actuar y Habilidades. Equipo y hechizos tambien suman TE al usarse.

- Lista de turnos de ataque -
 Al seleccionar una unidad en combate, la fila inferior muestra el orden TA previsto. Para ver el turno de todas las unidades, presiona el boton {icon 4} para ver la Lista de unidades y usa Ordenar unidades para verlas por orden de turno.
 Conviene saber que unidad actua despues. Evita acciones innecesarias para superar al enemigo.

english:
Each unit has Life and HP that represent their physical endurance. Units whose HP falls to 0 during battle are incapacitated, and will lose a point of life if not aided. When a unit's life is exhausted, it is dead and can no longer be revived.

- Incapacitation -
  A counter appears above the heads of units incapacitated when their HP falls to 0. Each attack turn the counter decreases by 1, and if it reaches 0 that unit loses a life and is withdrawn from the battlefield.

- Withdrawn Units -
  Units withdrawn from the battlefield cannot take further actions during the current battle. However, they can take part in later battles as long as they have at least one point of life remaining.

- Death -
  Units that have no remaining life are deceased. Death is not reversible, so they will no longer be able to fight at your side. You can either Dismiss a deceased unit or Scavenge Skills to remove it from your party.
spanish_current:
Cada unidad tiene Vida y PS que representan su resistencia fisica. Las unidades cuyo PS cae a 0 en batalla quedan incapacitadas y pierden un punto de vida si no se les ayuda. Cuando la vida de una unidad se agota, muere y ya no puede revivir.

- Incapacitacion -
 Un contador aparece sobre las unidades incapacitadas al caer su PS a 0. Cada turno de ataque el contador baja 1, y si llega a 0 la unidad pierde una vida y se retira del campo.

- Unidades retiradas -
 Las unidades retiradas del campo no pueden actuar mas en la batalla actual. Sin embargo, pueden participar en batallas futuras si les queda al menos un punto de vida.

- Muerte -
 Las unidades sin vida restante han fallecido. La muerte no es reversible, asi que no podras luchar a su lado. Puedes Despedir a una unidad fallecida o Extraer habilidades para sacarla de tu grupo.

  Units that have no remaining life are deceased. Death is not reversible, so they will no longer be able to fight at your side. You can either Dismiss a deceased unit or Scavenge Skills to remove it from your party.

english:
The movement range and elevation difference each unit can traverse vary depending on the movement type of its class. The skills assigned to a unit can also affect movement.
  The Move command can be reset and issued again up until the point another command is issued. This can be useful when you need to reposition a unit to be in range to attack.

- Crossing Gaps -

- Elevation Differences -
  The height a unit can jump up or down varies depending on its movement type. This can lead to situations where a unit can jump down to a lower spot but cannot climb back up, forcing a longer return route to be taken.

english:
Magic-using classes such as Wizards must first make the following preparations to use spells:

- Learning Spells -
  To learn a spell you must first obtain the corresponding arcana. When you have an arcana in your possession, the spell contained within can be learned by selecting Magic under the Party command. Spells can also be learned by using arcana as items during battle.

- Command Skills -
  To use a spell you have learned, you must also learn the command skill for the spell's elemental school. Once a command skill has been learned, it must be assigned before it can be used in battle. After a skill is assigned, it will appear under the Act command.

Example: Casting Heal
1. Obtain the Grimoire Vitalite.

2. Select Learn under Magic from the Party screen, and then select Grimoire Vitalite. The unit will learn the Heal spell.

3. Select Learn under Skills from the Party screen, and learn the Divine Magic command skill.

4. Select Assign under Skills from the Party screen, and assign the Divine Magic command skill.

english:
Some of the more common debuffs include petrify, poison, stun, sleep, and charm.

- Petrify -
  Petrified units are turned to stone, leaving them powerless to act. Weapon attacks against them will always hit, but the damage done will be greatly reduced. The debuff can be removed using magic or items, and will also fade after a certain number of attack turns.

- Poison -
  Poisoned units will take damage for a set number of turns. The debuff can be removed using magic or items, and will also fade after a certain amount of RT has passed.

- Stun -
  Stunned units have a certain chance of losing the ability to act. The debuff can be removed using magic or items, and will also fade after a certain number of attack turns.

- Sleep -
  Sleeping units remain stationary and their avoidance of weapon-based attacks is reduced to 0%. The debuff can be removed using magic or items, and will also fade when the unit takes damage or after a certain number of attack turns.

- Charm -
  Charmed units are temporarily confused and attack their allies. The debuff can be removed using magic or items, and will also fade when the unit takes damage or after a certain number of attack turns.

  There are many other debuffs besides those listed here. When a unit is affected by a debuff, you can view details about it using the Condition command.

 Las unidades petrificadas se vuelven piedra y no pueden actuar. Los ataques con armas siempre aciertan, pero el golpe se reduce mucho. El estado se quita con magia u objetos y pasa tras varios turnos de ataque.

- Veneno -
 Las unidades envenenadas reciben golpe por ciertos turnos. El estado se quita con magia u objetos y pasa tras pasar cierto TE.

- Paralizado   -
 Las unidades paralizadas tienen cierta probabilidad de perder la habilidad de actuar. El estado se quita con magia u objetos y pasa tras varios turnos de ataque. 

- Dormir -
 Las unidades dormidas se quedan quietas y su evasion a ataques de armas baja a 0%. El estado se quita con magia u objetos, o al recibir golpes o tras varios turnos de ataque.

- Encantamiento -
 Las unidades encantadas se confunden temporalmente y atacan a sus aliados. El estado se quita con magia u objetos, o al recibir golpes o tras varios turnos de ataque.

 Hay otros estados aparte de estos. Si una unidad sufre un estado, puedes ver detalles usando el comando Condicion.

english:
Experience points and skill points are calculated for the entire battle party and then distributed according to a number of rules.

- Experience Points -
  The experience point total is made up of the base value for the battle and the points added when enemy units are defeated. This number is then distributed based on the classes of the surviving party members. Classes with the greatest number of surviving units receive more experience points.

- Skill Points -
  Skill points are acquired through the actions taken by your units during battle, and then added to the battle party's skill point pool. The points in the pool are distributed evenly among surviving units once the battle is over.

- Zombies -
  Be wary if any of your surviving units are zombies. Units with this condition count towards the total for point distribution, but receive no actual experience or skill points, so their portion of the total is lost.
spanish_current:
Los puntos de experiencia y de habilidad se calculan para el grupo de batalla y se distribuyen segun varias reglas.

- Puntos de experiencia -
 El total de puntos de experiencia se forma con el valor base de la batalla y los puntos por derrotar unidades enemigas. Este numero se distribuye segun las clases de supervivientes del grupo. Las clases con mas unidades supervivientes reciben mas puntos de experiencia.

- Puntos de habilidad -
 Los puntos de habilidad se obtienen mediante las acciones de tus unidades en batalla y se anaden a la reserva del grupo. Los puntos de la reserva se distribuyen de forma equitativa entre las unidades supervivientes al terminar la batalla.

- Zombis -
 Cuidado si alguna unidad superviviente es un zombi. Las unidades con esta condicion cuentan para el total de la distribucion, pero no reciben puntos reales de experiencia ni de habilidad, por lo que su parte del total se pierde.

Each unit can equip up to 5 items. However, items can only be equipped to certain location slots.

- Left Hand/Right Hand -
  Weapons and shields are equipped to hand slots. Two one-handed weapons can be equipped at the same time, but only one two-handed weapon can be equipped. Shields can only be equipped in the left hand.
  
- Armor -
  Two pieces of armor can be equipped, covering head, body, arms, or legs.

- Jewelry -
  A single piece of jewelry can be equipped.

english:
Skills are abilities that each unit can learn by spending the skill points they acquire. Each class has access to different skills, but some can be used by other classes once they have been learned. You can increase the number of skill slots by spending skill points, up to a maximum of 10 slots.

  The four skill types are command, support, action, and special.

- Command Skills -
  These add sub-commands that can be accessed using the Act command. Includes skills such as Divine Magic.

- Support Skills -
  Support skills take effect automatically once they are assigned. There are many kinds, such as those that change movement type or increase attack power.

- Action Skills -
  Action skills can be executed using the Skills command once they are assigned. They require TP to use.

- Special Skills -
  These include skills such as dragon breath that are only available to certain races. They appear under the Act command.

  Units can gain proficiency with certain skills when they are used in battle, raising their skill rank. You may even acquire finishing moves unique to certain weapons by raising the skill rank of your weapon skills.

 Los cuatro tipos son comando, apoyo, accion y especial.

- Comando -
 Agregan subcomandos accesibles desde Actuar. Incluye magia divina.

- Apoyo -
 Surten efecto de forma automatica al asignarlas. Hay varias, como cambiar el movimiento o subir el ataque.

- Accion -
 Se ejecutan usando el comando Habilidades tras asignarlas. Requieren PT.

- Especiales -
 Incluyen aliento de dragon, disponibles solo para ciertas razas. Aparecen en Actuar.

 Las unidades ganan maestria al usarlas en batalla, subiendo su rango. Incluso puedes obtener golpes finales de armas al subir el rango de Habilidades de armas.

english:
You may be drawn into battle at locations on the world map you've visited before. These are known as optional battles.
  During optional battles you may face unique enemies and monsters that are seldom seen elsewhere. They're also a chance to obtain rare items. What's more, {hero} does not need to take part in optional battles, and you can even choose to retreat from them entirely.

- Two Forms of Retreat -
  You can retreat either while forming a battle party before battle, or after battle commences. If you retreat before entering battle, it does not count towards your battles fought. You can see how many battles you've fought in the Warren Report.

- Bow-Type Weapons -
  Bow-type weapons fire projectiles in an arc. Thrown stones are included in this category.

- Crossbow-Type Weapons -
  Crossbow-type weapons fire projectiles in a straight line. Ninja throwing blades are included in this category.

  When making a ranged attack from high ground, you can target units outside the normal weapon range. Conversely, when making a ranged attack from low ground, even targets within range can be difficult to hit.

- Armas de Ballesta -
 Las armas de tipo ballesta disparan proyectiles en linea recta. Las cuchillas ninja arrojadizas entran en esta categoria.

 Al atacar a distancia desde zonas altas, puedes apuntar a unidades fuera del rango normal. En cambio, al atacar desde zonas bajas, incluso los blancos dentro del rango pueden ser dificiles de golpear.

english:
Sometimes an attack causes the target to be moved back one tile. This is called knockback. Knockbacks can occur due to critical hits, as well as skills and specific weapon attacks.
  There are certain situations in which knockback is impossible. In general, knockback moves the target back one tile, but this does not occur if the tile in question contains an obstacle or another unit, or if it is at a higher elevation than the starting tile.

- Causing Knockback -
  It is difficult to make critical hits consistently. Attacking with a shield is a more reliable method. Shields usually have a higher chance of causing knockback. There are also skills that raise the chance of successfully knocking a target back.

- Using Knockback -
  If an enemy is knocked down from a certain height, it will take additional damage from the fall. The damage increases with elevation and the weight of the unit.
  Knocking enemies into chasms or off walls can also cause that unit to lose a life and be removed from the battlefield. However, flying units are not affected by this.

english:
Support skills take effect automatically once they are assigned.

- Rampart Aura -
  This skill limits the movement of enemy units. A yellow line encircles tiles surrounding units with this skill assigned. Walking units entering this area are forced to stop regardless of whether they have movement left.

- Counterattack -
  This skill triggers a counterattack following an attack by an enemy unit. Units with this skill assigned will counterattack when targeted by a melee attack as long as their equipped weapon has the necessary range.

  There are many other support skills, such as those that change movement type or increase attack. Choose skills that complement a unit's class and the layout of the battlefield.

- Contraataque -
 Esta habilidad activa un contraataque tras un ataque enemigo. Las unidades con esta habilidad contratacaran al recibir un golpe cuerpo a cuerpo si su arma equipada tiene el rango necesario.

 Hay otras habilidades de apoyo, como las que cambian el movimiento o suben el ataque. Elige habilidades que complementen la clase de la unidad y el terreno del campo.

english:
You can sometimes befriend enemy units by using skills such as Recruit, Coax, and Subdue during battle. The chance of success is affected by range, loyalty, and HP.

- Range -
  You should try to get as close as possible to units you want to recruit. They will often ignore you if you merely shout at them from afar.

- Loyalty -
  Check the loyalty of the enemy unit. Units with lower loyalty are easier to recruit. You can judge the loyalty of a unit from the select help text when its name is selected.

- HP -
  Try to reduce the HP of the enemy unit as much as possible to increase your chances of success. One tenth their maximum HP is a good target.

- Failed Recruitment -
  Each time you fail at recruiting, the target's loyalty increases, making the next attempt more difficult. Try to make the first time count.

Puedes hacer amistad con unidades enemigas usando habilidades como reclutar, persuadir y someter en batalla. La probabilidad de exito depende del rango, lealtad y PV.

- Rango -
 Intenta acercarte lo mas posible a las unidades que quieras reclutar. Suelen ignorarte si solo les gritas desde lejos.

- Lealtad -
 Revisa la lealtad de la unidad enemiga. Las unidades con menor lealtad son faciles de reclutar. Puedes juzgar la lealtad usando el texto de ayuda al seleccionarla.

- PV -
 Intenta reducir los PV de la unidad enemiga al maximo para subir tus opciones de exito. Un diez por ciento de sus PV maximos es una buena meta.

- Reclutamiento Fallido -
 Cada vez que fallas al reclutar, la lealtad del blanco sube y hace el proximo intento mas dificil. Intenta que el primero cuente.

english:
When battle ends, you will receive experience points, skill points, and the spoils of war. Units may also join or leave your party.

- Collecting Items -
  Bags of loot remaining on the battlefield are collected and the items inside added to your inventory. However, tarot cards are not recovered.

- Units Joining the Party -
  Enemy units you successfully recruit can be added to your party after the battle is over. If you already have the maximum number of units, you must either turn the new unit away or dismiss another unit first.

- Units Leaving the Party -
  If the loyalty of your units falls too low, they will leave after the battle is over. Take note if any of your units voice complaints at the end of a fight.

 Las unidades enemigas que reclutes con exito se pueden sumar a tu grupo al acabar la batalla. Si ya estas al maximo, debes rechazar o despedir a otra primero.

- Unidades Que Dejan el Grupo -
 Si la lealtad de tus unidades baja demasiado, se iran al terminar la batalla. Toma nota si alguna de tus unidades expresa quejas al final de un combate.

Cerya Phoraena, lider del frente, niega participar en estos crimenes y dice que es propaganda para desacreditar su causa.

  The Walister are growing in power, but they yet lack funds. It is thought they seek to profit from Phorampa's bountiful reserves.

Se cree que buscan lucrarse de las abundantes reservas de Phorampa.

english:
A massacre has taken place at Balmamusa. There are no survivors. Balmamusa was set aside for the Walister by the Kingdom of Galgastani, and all those who perished were of Walister blood. Women and children were spared no mercy as the town was engulfed in flames.
  The killings are thought to be an act of retribution by the Galgastani for the recapture of Almorica Castle by the Resistance. Hierophant Balbatos maintains he is not responsible.

english:
Valeria has a thriving sea trade, and many fortresses have been built to protect its ports from enemies. During King Dorgalua's reign soldiers of the Kingdom of Valeria were garrisoned at each fortress, but since the kingdom's downfall they have been manned sporadically at best. This has led to an increase in pirates, bandits, and army stragglers capturing the fortresses for their own use. Gecho Fortress on Beneceunga fell into pirate hands just the other day.
  As Gecho is south of the prominent trading port of Grimsby, merchants there are anxious to see the pirates routed from the fortress as soon as possible.

Valeria tiene un comercio maritimo prospero y muchas fortalezas protegen sus puertos de enemigos. Durante el reinado del rey Dorgalua soldados del reino de Valeria estaban guarnecidos en cada fortaleza pero desde la caida del reino se han ocupado de forma esporadica. Esto aumento los piratas bandidos y desertores que toman fortalezas para su uso. La fortaleza Gecho en Beneceunga cayo en manos piratas el otro dia.
 Como Gecho esta al sur del puerto comercial de Grimsby los mercaderes de alli desean ver a los piratas expulsados de la fortaleza lo antes posible.

english:
The Bay of Gobanda is known for the thick fog that hangs over its waters. It was recently discovered that an immense tower lies hidden within the fog.
  Scholars from the Royal Academy say it once stood in the ancient city of San Bronsa, which was destroyed in Dorgalua's great war. The Bay of Gobanda was formed when magic wielded by King Rodrick of Brigantys shattered the lands in the last days of the war, also destroying San Bronsa.
  Scholars had studied the tower before the great war, but it is still not known when it was built, or by whom. It is said the Hanging Gardens built by King Dorgalua were inspired by the tower of San Bronsa.
  As news of the tower's discovery spreads there is concern it will be looted by thieves, and the Resistance is considering sending an exploratory party there. There have been further reports of a large island floating in the sky above the bay, but nothing more is known at this point.

La bahia de Gobanda se formo cuando la magia esgrimida por el rey Rodrick de Brigantys destrozo las tierras en los ultimos dias del conflicto, destruyendo tambien San Bronsa.
  Eruditos estudiaron la torre antes de la gran guerra, pero aun no se sabe cuando fue construida ni por quien. Se dice que los Jardines Colgantes construidos por el rey Dorgalua se inspiraron en la torre de San Bronsa.
  Al difundirse el descubrimiento de la torre, temen que sea saqueada por ladrones, y la Resistencia considera enviar una partida exploratoria alli. Hay reportes de una gran isla flotante sobre la bahia, mas nada se sabe ahora.

english:
Many strange rumors have been circulating of late. People thought dead have been seen walking about, and the same person sighted in two places at once. Normally little stock would be put into such rumors, but there is much talk about these incidents among scholars and mages. Some believe them the work of the Apocrypha, others attribute them to some arcane art brought from Lodis.
  A common thread is found throughout these reports. The young hero of the Resistance, {hero}, is always mentioned by witnesses.
  {hero} is famed as a warrior and tactician, but few know of his penchant for collecting tarot cards. He is apparently particularly fond of the Wheel of Fortune card. It is not clear how this relates to the current rumors, but the Wheel of Fortune card has long been a symbol of regret and atonement in Valeria. It would not be beyond reason for {hero} himself to be struggling with such feelings, having experienced war at such a young age.
  What would one do if the power to bend time fell into our hands? One could repeat an exercise, knowing the best solution in advance. Or learn a lover plans to leave you before they speak a word. And who would not go back to save the lives of fallen comrades?
  However, one thing must be kept in mind: A different past is no guarantee of a happier future. Changing what has happened may in fact have no effect at all on the here and the now.

Normalmente no se creeria en tales rumores, pero estudiosos y magos hablan mucho de estos incidentes. Unos creen que es obra de los Apocrifos, otros los atribuyen a un arte arcano traido de Lodis.
  Hay un hilo comun en estos reportes. El joven heroe de la Resistencia, {hero}, es mencionado siempre por los testigos.
  {hero} es famoso como guerrero y estratega, pero pocos saben de su aficion por coleccionar cartas del tarot. Al parecer le gusta mucho la carta de la Rueda de la Fortuna. No esta claro como se relaciona esto con los rumores actuales, pero la carta de la Rueda de la Fortuna ha sido por mucho tiempo un simbolo de pesar y expiacion en Valeria. No seria descabellado que el propio {hero} luche con tales sentimientos, tras vivir la guerra a tan corta edad.

  Sin embargo, hay que tener algo presente: un pasado diferente no es garantia de un futuro mas feliz. Cambiar lo ocurrido podria de hecho no tener ningun efecto en el aqui y el ahora.

english:
In times long past, mankind was engaged in a bitter battle with the forces of evil for supremacy over the land. Man drew strength from their gods, while the forces of evil suckled at the power of the Abyss. In the end, the people could do nothing against the overwhelming might of evil, and were pushed to the brink of destruction.
  It was at this time a group of three knights and twelve sages descended from the heavens and sealed the Chaos Gate that linked our world with the Abyss. The tide was turned, and man emerged victorious. Thus man came to rule and build the civilizations that stand today.
  The battle won, the three knights returned to the heavens, while the twelve sages remained to spread knowledge among the people. However, a burden yet weighed on their hearts. When the forces of evil fled, they foretold another Ogre Battle would occur. One of the knights bestowed a sword upon man that would grant the power to call the gods once more.

english:
On the island of Oedlark off the southernmost tip of Valeria are a series of undersea caverns known as the Pirate's Graveyard. They are legendary among treasure hunters, said to hold untold riches in their depths.
  The caverns are known for one other thing: countless pirates and thieves have sought to claim the treasures of the cavern as their own, but most lose their lives before even setting foot inside.
  Currents from the south and northwest converge in the waters surrounding the Pirate's Graveyard, and its reefs make navigation difficult for all but the most skilled sailors.
  Upon reaching the caverns explorers must contend with all manner of deadly creatures, and it is littered with the corpses of failed adventurers. It is no wonder that none have yet claimed the treasures said to lie within.

  Las cavernas son conocidas por otra cosa: incontables piratas y ladrones buscan apoderarse de sus tesoros, pero casi todos pierden la vida antes de entrar.
  Corrientes del sur y noroeste convergen en sus aguas, y los arrecifes dificultan la navegacion salvo a marineros muy diestros.
  Al llegar, los exploradores deben luchar contra criaturas mortales, y el lugar esta lleno de cuerpos de aventureros caidos. No sorprende que nadie haya reclamado aun los tesoros de su interior.

Six fortresses scattered across Valeria serve to protect it from foreign enemies. But few are aware that these were not built as strongholds. The fortresses were temples dedicated to the six daughters of the Great Father Philaha.
  The temple areas remain today, but the entryways from the fortifications were sealed during the reign of King Dorgalua. No one knows why the temples were sealed off, or how the seals can be broken.

english:
The fifteen years of war before Valeria was unified is known as Dorgalua's great war.
  Before the unification, Valeria was divided into the five kingdoms of Barnicia, Phidoch, Almorica, Coritanae, and Brigantys. Each sought to expand their territory, and relations were volatile to say the least.
  The great war began after Lord Clemont of Barnicia was assassinated by armed militia seeking to usurp his leadership. The delicate balance of power soon crumbled, with Phidoch gathering its military might and declaring war on Barnicia and Almorica, while Coritanae joined the fray as Almorica's ally.
  The war stretched on for eight years, with Phidoch eventually occupying Barnicia and Almorica and installing governments there. Phidoch ruler King Ramonica was a Bakram, and he began suppressing the Walister, causing friction between the peoples that continues to this day. Great numbers of partisans struggled against him.
  Phidoch attacked Coritanae, and when formerly neutral Brigantys joined the war at the behest of Coritanae, the war spread throughout the entire Valerian Isles. Fighting soon reached a stalemate, but Brigantys began secretly supporting partisan groups, who then formed a rebel army in Barnicia.
  Coritanae ruler Count Orlandeau was killed in battle, and Coritanae fell under the rule of Brigantys. The rebel army of Barnicia then turned on Phidoch. Future king Dorgalua was leader of this rebel army. Beset on both flanks by Brigantys and the rebels, Phidoch fell at last, bringing the conflict to an end.   
  King Rodrick of Brigantys agreed to a truce with Dorgalua, but the conditions favored one side greatly, and it was broken within a month. Fighting began anew. The battle between Rodrick and Dorgalua continued for another year, with Dorgalua ultimately winning victory. Valeria was united under a single ruler at last.

english:
It is not commonly known that the Brigania Flats were once a lush paradise. The Bay of Gobanda was also once an inland area.
  In the final days of Dorgalua's great war, the lands were shattered by a man named Rodrick Desmoria, who was once King of Brigantys.
  He fought alongside King Dorgalua to unite Valeria, but in the end became his mortal enemy. He is known for using forbidden magic to wipe out those who opposed him. Though his reputation is marred by this, King Rodrick was an austere ruler who would not stand for injustice or compromise. He at first resolved to use the Apocrypha to aid his people, but it was this act that caused them to turn against him.
  It is said he died in captivity at Brigantys Castle after his defeat at the hands of King Dorgalua. Until his death he muttered constantly of the injustice he had suffered, and some say his spirit was called to the Palace of the Dead after his passing.

  Lucho junto al rey Dorgalua para unificar Valeria, pero al final se convirtio en su enemigo mortal. Se le conoce por usar magia prohibida para exterminar a sus opositores. english:
The war is at an end, and peace has returned to Valeria. Reconstruction work is moving at a swift pace across the lands, and although trade has not reached its previous levels, it recovers day by day. The markets once again throng with people, and fresh vegetables and fruit from far away countries line the stalls. The lively seafaring country of Valeria is back to its old self.
  Yet many still bear the wounds of war. Veterans of the fighting are left scarred, dealing with lost limbs, blindness, and paralysis.
  Princess Versalia has ordered these soldiers be granted a benefit through the Order of Philaha. This may cost up to a quarter of the kingdom's budget, and could climb to almost half if compensation for civilians is also approved.
  Those dealing with postwar matters such as these are at a loss to help those suffering trauma from the horrors they faced in the war. In many cases this trauma affects the everyday lives of victims, causing insomnia and anxiety, and it can only be alleviated through medicinal means. Sufferers sometimes turn to drink as a way of escape, and it is clear this is a problem than cannot be resolved through medical care alone.
  Archiereus Mreuva Phoraena heads a committee dealing with the postwar recovery that pledges support to all, regardless of background, class, or profession. Those seeking help should inquire at the nearest abbey.
